limitations: Browser automation did not reach page rendering: Chromium and Edge exited during process startup in this Windows session; no screenshot or frontend interaction is claimed as verified.

Rejected chunk count is not exposed by the current API; it is null, not inferred.
The dataset-export mirror was copied into this isolated run and the uniquely named workspace mirror was removed; set CLARION_DISABLE_WORKSPACE_DATASET_MIRROR=1 for isolated runs.
